# SpeakStone voice pack: Forever Audio Pack 1

WoW Forever quests, part 1 of 2, voiced for SpeakStone, with voices similar to the in-game characters.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

Website: https://speakstone.beanw.co.uk

**This pack is audio only and needs [SpeakStone Forever](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main).** On its own it does nothing.

![Welcome tutorial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/01_welcome_tutorial.png)

## What it does

SpeakStone reads World of Warcraft out loud. Open a quest, talk to an NPC or read a book, and you hear it in a voice
similar to the in-game character who says it, not one generic narrator. The same NPC keeps the same voice in their
quests, their greetings and their books. This pack holds the lines for: **WoW Forever quests, part 1 of 2**.

- **Choose how it reads:** full narration, story only or manual; a compact speech bar, subtitles or audio only; a
  portrait or a moving 3D head of the speaker.
- **Walk away and keep listening:** the speech bar carries on after you leave the NPC, and the next line waits its turn.
- **Read-along:** the words being spoken are highlighted as the voice reads them. **Pause and Resume** pick up from where you stopped.
- **Controller and TV support**, **Dialogue UI support**, **dyslexia-friendly fonts** and three themes.
- **The SpeakStone Guide:** browse and play every voiced quest, greeting and book in game.

## How it works

1. **[SpeakStone Forever](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main) is the player.** It holds the code, the settings, the Guide and the text, but no audio.
2. **The voice packs hold the audio** (Audio Packs 1 and 2 (quests), Audio Pack 3 (books) and Chatter (greetings)). When the game loads, this pack registers its lines with the base
   add-on. A line whose pack is missing is simply silent.
3. **When a quest, greeting or book opens**, SpeakStone looks the line up and plays it if a pack has it. Long lines are
   stored in parts of about 10 to 15 seconds, cut in natural pauses, so Pause and Resume carry on from where you stopped.
4. **Lines with no voice yet are saved as you play.** Export them from the minimap button (right-click) and paste them
   on the [website](https://speakstone.beanw.co.uk/), or let the free SpeakStone Worker app send them. New lines are
   usually voiced by the next day and arrive in the packs with their next update.

Full details, commands and the rest of the screenshots: [SpeakStone Forever README](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main#readme).

## Install

1. [SpeakStone Forever](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main) (the base add-on, required).
2. All four Forever packs: [Forever Audio Pack 1](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack1), [Forever Audio Pack 2](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack2), [Forever Audio Pack 3](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack3), [Forever Chatter](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Chatter).

The tutorial and the Guide's Voice packs tab list any pack you are missing.

## The other packs

- [Forever Audio Pack 2](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack2)
- [Forever Audio Pack 3](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack3)
- [Forever Chatter](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Chatter)

Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

## 6.0.0 (November 2026)

**6.0.0 is a big one: the voices have been overhauled, and characters now speak with emotion.**

### Highlights
- **New voices with emotion**: Thousands of lines re-recorded. Characters now sound angry, sad, afraid, happy or surprised where the line calls for it, sentence by sentence, instead of reading everything in one tone.
- **Stage directions acted, not read out**: Lines such as ** or ** are now performed with a sound instead of being spoken as words.
- **Natural pauses**: Longer breaths between sentences, and quick back-to-back short sentences keep their pace.
- **Audio Pack 3**: Some quests moved from Audio Packs 1 and 2 to Audio Pack 3 to keep every pack under the download size limit. Install all three Audio Packs plus Chatter; the add-on tells you if one is missing.

### Heads up
This is a large change, so there may be bugs: a line in the wrong voice, a missing clip, or an odd pause. Please report anything you hear at speakstone.beanw.co.uk or on our GitHub issues page and we will fix it.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment. The voices are similar to the in-game characters.

## 5.0.0 (November 2026)

A new language model has been yet again used (3rd time lucky) for voice generation across SpeakStone!

### Highlights
- **Emotions for NPC Voices**: Characters now express emotion fitting the context of their dialogue (anger, sorrow, joy, fear, surprise, whisper, and more).
- **Stage Directions**: In-game stage directions and narrative descriptions are now voiced, e.g. *"[Susan looks at her feet and see's they are full of mud, on closer inspection, it's not mud, its cow poo]"*.
- **Voice Overhaul**: Thousands of lines regenerated with the new voice engine for improved quality, emotion, and character depth across Retail and WoW Forever.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment. The voices are similar to the in-game characters.

# SpeakStone 4.1.2

Voices similar to the in-game characters. Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

Version 4.1.2 covers the base add-ons, every retail sound pack and every WoW Forever pack.

## What's new

- About 1,300 more lines re-recorded after player and owner reports, mostly Kul Tiran, Tauren, Goblin and Dracthyr characters.
- 51 characters who had lines waiting without a voice now speak, including Breem, Ba'kel, Katy Stampwhistle, One-Eyed Thak and the Mnemis keepers in Bastion.
- Nine characters the game shows as either a man or a woman now have a voice for each, and you hear the one that matches the character in front of you (for example Alliance Worker, Dark Iron Grenadier, Forsaken Dreadmage, Zandalari Vagrant and Tortollan Seeker).
- Colonel Troteman (Redridge Mountains) has a new voice that fits him.
- Goblin voices were shared out more evenly, so fewer goblins sound alike.
- Quest titles, character names, books and greetings in the Audio Library updated to match the new lines.

## Thank you

Thank you to everyone who sent in quest text, flagged a line or reported a problem. Want to help? Send in quest text, report a line or flag a voice at https://speakstone.beanw.co.uk.
